LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
Trestle ~1.98 km at 178 deg; ~2.45 km per line tank to platform (D-013). Expansion loops (flat),
guides, drip trays not shown (D-021); no low-point drain or vent on the trestle runs (D-036).
Circulation (holding): P-2102 / P-3102 -> LNG-2002 -> line A -> XV-4103 -> line B -> LNG-4005 (D-008).
Loading: both lines to the loading berth, the second through LNG-4010 / XV-4107 (DN 800); XV-4103 closed (D-034).
Trestle side of XV-5101 / -6101: welded, no tapping (D-036). LNG-4003 / LNG-4010: bottom-of-line tees;
the loading lines fall to them, no pocket (D-036). SB: spec break.
UZ-4101 / UZ-4102: C&E I-501, I-601 (also ESD-2, I-503 / I-603, and the air trip I-804); air accumulator, closure 25-30 s (D-016).
LNG-3002 (DN 250): T-3101 circulation; LNG-4008 (DN 80): spray to the desuperheater; N-4001 / -4002 (DN 80): N2, SEQ-LINE-EMPTY, bleeds N-4003 / -4004;
BOG-4011 / -4012 / -4015 / -4016 (DN 25): thermal relief PSV-4111 / -4112 / -4113 / -4114 (15.0 barg) into BOG-4001 on the tank side of XV-4135.
BOG-4013 / BOG-4014 (DN 300): carrier de-inerting and cool-down vapour to the flare; AI-4133 / AI-4134 (N2, O2, CH4) switch each vapour return
make-before-break between the tank vapour header (XV-4135 / XV-4136) and the flare (XV-4131 / XV-4132): C&E I-511..I-513 with ZSO-4131 / ZSO-4135,
I-611..I-613 with ZSO-4132 / ZSO-4136. ESD-1 (I-501 / I-601) opens XV-4135 / XV-4136 and never closes the vapour return, the relief path
of the berth; XV-4131 / XV-4132 close only once XV-4135 / XV-4136 are proven open (I-513 / I-613). XV-4135 / -4136 fail open, XV-4131 / -4132 fail closed (D-026.1).
